svg.title: Two minutes of heart rate, against a recording and a formula
svg.desc: Two minutes of heart rate sampled every second. The Runsketch trace averages 170.3 bpm and the Garmin fenix 2 recording 170.1, so both are drawn on the same beats-per-minute axis, and the two seconds the watch skipped are left as gaps. Both move in small steps and hold the same value for seconds at a time, wandering a few beats across the window, with the Runsketch trace swinging a little wider. The fakemy.run formula sits about twenty beats lower, near 149 bpm, and jumps between 134 and 164 from one second to the next, a jagged band with no inertia, because its noise is redrawn independently at every track point.
